evidence: The implementation and use of new and evolving Artificial Intelligence ("AI") technologies present uncertainties and challenges.
The development and implementation of AI technologies is complex, and there are technical challenges associated with achieving the optimal level of accuracy, efficiency and reliability.
The algorithms and models used in AI systems may have limitations, including biases, errors, or inability to handle certain data types or scenarios.
The use of AI technologies by financial institutions and their customers, and the regulatory framework and expectations surrounding the use of AI technologies, are in their early stages.

ai_positioning.summary: TMP adopte une posture défensive face à l'IA, mettant l'accent sur les risques technologiques, réglementaires et opérationnels liés à l'implémentation de ces technologies dans le secteur financier, sans indication d'initiatives propres de développement ou d'intégration.
